lina: Need a small asset set for the Apr webinar inbound push. One hero benchmark (wide), 2-slide funnel SVG, 3 social cards (static + tiny sparkline GIF), landing thumbnail copy-first, and email badge. Deadline: comps tomorrow 11am PT.

paul: We can do it. Quick Q: hero dimensions? OG 1200x630 or 1600x900? Which metric pair?

lina: Use 1600x900. Plot cost_per_1000 (x) vs p95_ms (y). No numeric claims, just labeled clusters: "lower-cost" / "lower-latency".

ari: Brand/legal: use type scale v2, neutral background for charts, footer lockup reads "Redwood Inference  production-ready inference" and source line "internal benchmark; illustrative". Avoid gradients on chart.

kevin: Animation note: sparkline 10-12 frames, subtle, keep GIF <1.6MB for IG. Provide MP4 fallback for LinkedIn. Export SVG funnels with <desc> alt text.

lina: Deliverable names follow MIQ_launch2026_{asset}_{channel}_{variant}. Example: MIQ_launch2026_herobench_og_static. Tag Figma frames with release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14.

paul: Need CSV and copy variants today to hit the timeline. Also will bin p95 > 2000ms outliers per product ask.

lina: Uploading metrics now: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/launch-apr.csv. CTAs: "Try a demo", "Watch on demand", APAC short: "Demo", "Watch".

ari: I'll run a quick brand + legal sweep once comps are up. Keep annotations qualitative.

design-bot: Reminder: automated export only picks frames tagged release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14. Use naming convention and include alt text in component descriptions.

paul: OK locking scope. We'll post first comps by 09:45 PT. Lina, pls confirm landing copy when ready.

lina: Will post copy in 20m. Thanks :sparkles:
